supporting_observations.claim: Repeated svc-billing authentication failures occurred on FILE-PIN-01 from 13:31 through 13:46 UTC. The 4625 records show LogonType 3 and SubStatus 0xc000006a, and the corresponding DC records show bad-password status 0xc000006a.

The failures recur at roughly one-minute intervals and identify FILE-PIN-01 as the workstation, with source address 10.51.20.20; this pattern is consistent with the inventory-described BillingSync job re-authenticating with a stale password after the scheduled rotation, but does not prove that explanation.

At 14:08 UTC, WS-ESTONE-01 recorded explicit use of svc-billing credentials targeting FILE-PIN-01 by taskhostw.exe running as SYSTEM. This is a different source host from the repeated failures and is not explained by the supplied evidence.
The supplied records do not show whether the 14:08 explicit-credential use succeeded; the record establishes credential use was attempted, not a successful logon or malicious intent.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied evidence contains authentication events only; it does not include BillingSync job or password-rotation logs, process execution details beyond the recorded process name and PID, or a corresponding success/failure outcome for the 14:08 explicit-credential event.
The evidence ends at 14:08 UTC, so it does not establish what happened during the remainder of the requested review window.
claims_not_established: Whether the svc-billing password rotation completed successfully at 13:30 UTC or when the BillingSync job was updated.
Whether the 14:08 credential use from WS-ESTONE-01 was authorized, what initiated taskhostw.exe, or whether it resulted in a successful logon.
Whether the repeated failures were solely caused by the scheduled job retaining an old password, or whether another actor or process contributed.
additional_evidence_needed: Verify the password-rotation and BillingSync update timestamps, job configuration, and run history on FILE-PIN-01.
Collect FILE-PIN-01 and DC-PIN-01 authentication records after 14:08 UTC, including any successful svc-billing logons and their source addresses.

Investigate WS-ESTONE-01 task and process history around 14:08 UTC, including taskhostw.exe parent/task details and the origin of the explicit credentials; confirm with the responsible operator whether this use was authorized.
